verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੈਦ ਬੈਦ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਰੋਗ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise birathaava(n)t ja(n)t poochhai baidh baidh prat jau lau na miTat rog tau lau bilalaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a patient describes his pain and discomfort to many physicians and doctors and ask for necessary cure, and till such times he is cured and become healthy, he keeps crying and wailing due to pain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੀਖ ਮਾਂਗਤ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਵੈ ਚੈਨ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਅਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bheekh maa(n)gat bhikhaaree ghar ghar ddolai tau lau nahee(n) aavai chain jau lau na aghaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a beggar wanders from door to door in search of alms and he is not satisfied till his hunger is appeased.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਸੌਨ ਸਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਸੋਧੈ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise birahanee sauan sagan lagan sodhai jau lau na bhataar bheTai tau lau akulaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife separated from her husband, searches for auspicious moments, omens and remains restless till her dear husband meets her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜੈ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੮੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise khojee khojai al kamal kamal gat jau lau na param padh sa(n)puT samaat hai ||587||

en.bdb: Similarly, like a bumblebee searching for lotus flowers gets arrested in the flower when sucking its nectar, a seeker desiring union with his beloved Lord searches for the Naam till he gets absorbed in the supreme spiritual state while practicing it. (587)
